correct_query: SELECT T1.channel_type FROM channels AS T1 INNER JOIN direct_links AS T2 ON T1.channel_id = T2.channel_id WHERE T2.user_a = 'U1' AND T2.user_b = 'U2' OR T2.user_b = 'U1' AND T2.user_a = 'U2'

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant replaces INNER JOIN with an IN subquery over channel_id, collapsing duplicate rows when both symmetric (user_a, user_b) composite-PK pairs reference the same channel_id.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT channel_type FROM channels WHERE channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM direct_links WHERE (user_a = 'U1' AND user_b = 'U2') OR (user_a = 'U2' AND user_b = 'U1'))
